title: Family chat
summary: A chat for the whole family: messages live in a shared table that every phone sees live.
done: Your chat is shared: each message sent arrives at once on every phone that has the app open. Publish it to install it on the family's phones.

welcome.text: Chat messages must be the same for everyone: we will keep them in a **shared** table, kept by the server. You need to be signed in.

shared.text: In **Where the rows live**, choose **Shared**: the rows will be on the server, the same for everyone. Keep “read and change”.

bind.text: Select the **Data list** and bind it to “Messages”: the title to “Text”, the subtitle to “Author”.

send.text: Add [when {{Button}} is clicked] then [add a row to Messages]: plug [text of {{TextInput}}] into “Author” and [text of {{TextInput.2}}] into “Text”.

run.text: In the preview, type your name and a message, then press **{{Button}}**.

two-phones.text: Open **Test** and scan the QR code with a phone: send a message from there, it shows up here too!
